status: prospective frozen dictionary; motif strings and polarities are literature-derived, never fit on this project's localization_effect labels
notes: Motifs are DNA alphabet ACGT; U in RNA inputs is mapped to T before matching.
Overlapping occurrences count with a non-overlapping left-to-right scan per motif.
Polarity +1 favors neurite/peripheral localization hypotheses from the cited sources; -1 favors nuclear retention / soma-biased hypotheses.
N-zip assay outcomes are not used; only published element definitions are encoded.

elements.rationale: let-7 seed / binding related element identified as a neuronal zipcode-associated sequence element in Mendonsa et al., Nat Neurosci 2023 (N-zip); presence hypothesized to favor neurite localization
compact let-7 family seed core used as a secondary published seed pattern; same polarity hypothesis
(AU)n / AU-rich zipcode-associated motif class reported in N-zip analyses
longer (AU)n tract; counted separately so lengthening an AU tract changes score
core fragment associated with the classical beta-actin zipcode literature (Kislauskis / Singer line); coarse proxy, not a full secondary-structure zipcode model
GC-rich repetitive pattern used as a published-class proxy for nuclear-retention / non-neurite bias in sequence-element screens; polarity opposite to neurite-favoring elements
elements.citation: literature proxy; see SRLE-seq / nuclear-retention score discussions in 2026 localization screens

elements.rationale: CTA-rich transport-associated hexamer class recurring in neuronal localization motif summaries
elements.citation: composite published motif class; treated as a frozen hypothesis, not re-estimated here

scrambled_null_rule: reverse each motif string and flip polarity signs; same counting procedure
